dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「鍵閉めた〜？」

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「閉めたよ」

鍵をポケットにしまって、施錠を確かめるため
に扉をひっぱる。
dialogues.en:
I pulled the door to check if the door has been locked as I
put my keys in my pocket.
dialogues.text:
I pulled the door to check if the door has been locked as I
put my keys in my pocket.

dialogues.jp: 「うっし」

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「窓も閉めてきた？　ガスの元栓は？」
dialogues.en: "Did you close the window? What about the gas?"
dialogues.text: "Did you close the window? What about the gas?"

dialogues.jp:
玄関から出てきた俺を音夢が上目遣いに見上げ
る。
dialogues.en: Nemu looked up to me as I came out of the house.
dialogues.text: Nemu looked up to me as I came out of the house.

dialogues.jp: 「ちゃんと全部閉めた」

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「ホント？」

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「お前は｛こじゅうと／小姑｝か……」

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「小姑って――」

俺の｛にら／睨｝みに、しかし音夢も腕を組んで目を細め
る。
dialogues.en:
Nemu folded her arms and narrowed her eyes to look back at
me as I stared at her.
dialogues.text:
Nemu folded her arms and narrowed her eyes to look back at
me as I stared at her.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「この年の女の子つかまえて小姑ってねぇ……
　もう、そんなことじゃ兄さん、お｛むこ／婿｝さんにな
　れなくなるよ？」
dialogues.en:
"How could you call a young girl like me a mother-in-law?
You should worry about yourself. You can't get married if
you're like that."
dialogues.text:
"How could you call a young girl like me a mother-in-law?
You should worry about yourself. You can't get married if
you're like that."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「俺が婿に行くんじゃなくて、お前が嫁に行く
　んだろうが」
dialogues.en: "I'm not marrying into someone else's family. You are."
dialogues.text: "I'm not marrying into someone else's family. You are."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「は？　どうして私が無精の兄さんを置いて、
　お嫁さんに行くのよ」
dialogues.en: "What? How could I get married leaving you behind?"
dialogues.text: "What? How could I get married leaving you behind?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「なんだそれ？」

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「ふっ。甲斐性無しの兄さんがひとりになった
　ら、掃除も洗濯も面倒だって、家がどうなる
　か怖くて……」
dialogues.en:
"I'm so worried what the house will be like if I leave you.
You're so lazy, you can't do anything by yourself."
dialogues.text:
"I'm so worried what the house will be like if I leave you.
You're so lazy, you can't do anything by yourself."

dialogues.jp: 無精で甲斐性なしかい。

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「言葉につまるってことは、自分でもそう思っ
　ている証拠よね」
dialogues.en:
"See? You must know that, since you aren't talking back to
me at all."
dialogues.text:
"See? You must know that, since you aren't talking back to
me at all."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「ぐ……！　ま、まぁ、そうだな。料理の出来
　ないお前が嫁に行けることもあるまい」
dialogues.en:
"Mm...... Well, fine. I guess you won't be getting married
any time soon since you can't cook."
dialogues.text:
"Mm...... Well, fine. I guess you won't be getting married
any time soon since you can't cook."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「うぐぐぐ！」

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「む〜……って、バカなことやってないで、早
　く学園に行くわよ」
dialogues.en: "Fine, we have to quit all of this. Let's go to school."
dialogues.text: "Fine, we have to quit all of this. Let's go to school."

dialogues.jp: 肩の力を抜いて、音夢がてへへ、と笑う。
dialogues.en: Nemu smiles in a relaxed mood.
dialogues.text: Nemu smiles in a relaxed mood.

dialogues.jp:
「そうだな……でも、とりあえずお前が先に嫁
　に行けよ」
dialogues.en:
"I guess...... But I still think you should get married
first."
dialogues.text:
"I guess...... But I still think you should get married
first."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「なに、まだ、こだわってるの？」

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「順番だよ。お前が嫁に行くのを見届けるのが、
　死んだ父親代わりの俺の役目だ」
dialogues.en:
"We have to take turns. I think it's my duty to make sure
you get married for dad's sake."
dialogues.text:
"We have to take turns. I think it's my duty to make sure
you get married for dad's sake."

dialogues.jp: 腕を組んでしみじみと頷く。
dialogues.en: I folded my arms and nodded nostalgically.
dialogues.text: I folded my arms and nodded nostalgically.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「……お父さん死んでないわよ」

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「ん？　おぉ！　あんまりにも影が薄いんで忘
　れてたぞ」

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「笑顔で言うことじゃないでしょうが……」
dialogues.en: I forgot because he's gone all the time.
dialogues.text: I forgot because he's gone all the time.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「ははははは」
思わず笑って誤魔化す。
すまんな親父。

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「はぁ……順番なら、やっぱり兄さんが先で
　しょ。兄妹なんだから」

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「どうせなら、誕生日一緒なんだし同じ日に結
　婚すれば問題なしなのにな」
dialogues.en:
"When you talk about turns, you have to get married first.
You're older."
dialogues.text:
"When you talk about turns, you have to get married first.
You're older."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「えっ？」
dialogues.en:
"I guess we should get married on the same day since we're
born on the same day."
dialogues.text:
"I guess we should get married on the same day since we're
born on the same day."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「同じ式場を借りれば安く済む」

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「そ、そ、そん、そんなこと――」
dialogues.en: "It'll be cheaper if we use the same venue."
dialogues.text: "It'll be cheaper if we use the same venue."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「だって、それって……その……駄目だよ兄妹
　でそんなこと」

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「兄妹だからいいんじゃないか？」
dialogues.en: "Well, because...... we're brother and sister, and......"
dialogues.text: "Well, because...... we're brother and sister, and......"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「ほらっ、世間的に色々とあるでしょ。そもそ
　も兄さんと……それは……う〜」

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.en:
"Well, I don't know what people say, and we are......
ah......"
dialogues.text:
"Well, I don't know what people say, and we are......
ah......"

dialogues.jp: なんだコイツ？

「あ、ほら、恋人もいないのに結婚の話とかし
　てたら、ずんずん心が……」

dialogues.en:
"See, I'm starting to feel sad talking about weddings when I
don't even have a girlfriend......"
dialogues.text:
"See, I'm starting to feel sad talking about weddings when I
don't even have a girlfriend......"

dialogues.jp: なんとなく胸をおさえる。
心が痛くない――どころか、なんか心地よい。
「はて？」
dialogues.en: I'm not even sad, but rather comfortable.
dialogues.text: I'm not even sad, but rather comfortable.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「うにゃ？　なにやってる？」
ひょっこりと隣の家からさくらが顔を出す。
dialogues.en: Sakura looked through the window since she lives next door.
dialogues.text: Sakura looked through the window since she lives next door.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「ちわちわ｛ちわげんか／痴話喧嘩｝？　怒りやすい人はミルク
　飲むと良いよ。背も伸びるし」
dialogues.en:
"Having a fight? You should drink more milk if you get upset
often. And it'll help you grow as well."
dialogues.text:
"Having a fight? You should drink more milk if you get upset
often. And it'll help you grow as well."

dialogues.jp: さくらが牛乳受けから牛乳のビンを取り出す。
dialogues.en: Sakura took out a bottle of milk.
dialogues.text: Sakura took out a bottle of milk.

dialogues.jp: 「……まったく説得力がないな」
dialogues.en: "......It doesn't sound convincing when you say that."
dialogues.text: "......It doesn't sound convincing when you say that."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「い、いえ。ちょっと婿に行くか嫁に行くかで
　口論に……」
dialogues.en:
"Oh, no. We were just arguing about who's going to get
married first."
dialogues.text:
"Oh, no. We were just arguing about who's going to get
married first."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「にゃ〜、どっちが？」

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「音夢だ」

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「だから兄さんと一緒だって――」
dialogues.en: "No, like I said, we have to go together......"
dialogues.text: "No, like I said, we have to go together......"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「そうだね。そうそう。お兄ちゃんはボクと結
　婚するからね♪」
dialogues.en: "I see. Oh, by the way, oniichan's going to marry me."
dialogues.text: "I see. Oh, by the way, oniichan's going to marry me."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「はぁ？」

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「えっ！　ちょっと、それは駄目！」

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「にゃ？」

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「そうそう」

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「うにゃあ！」

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「ははは、どんどん猫化しているぞお前は」

耳でも生えてきてしまいそうなので、さくらの
頭に手をのせる。
dialogues.en:
I put my hand on her head since she might grow a cat ear
soon.
dialogues.text:
I put my hand on her head since she might grow a cat ear
soon.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「あぁ、もう！！　いい加減こんなバカ話して
　ないで！」
音夢が珍しく地団太踏んでどなる。
dialogues.en:
Nemu stamped her feet in frustration and yelled out, which
was unusual for her.
dialogues.text:
Nemu stamped her feet in frustration and yelled out, which
was unusual for her.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「ほらっ、さっきから一歩も学園に向かってな
　いしぃ！」

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「い〜っぽ」
とん、と１歩だけ歩いて笑う。
「歴史的な瞬間だ」

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「……お望みなら月面まで吹き飛ばすわよ」
dialogues.en: "I'll blow you to the moon if you want me to."
dialogues.text: "I'll blow you to the moon if you want me to."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「じゃあさくら。俺は星にされる前に学園に急
　がなくてはいけなくてな」
dialogues.en:
"Okay, Sakura. I have to go to school before she makes me
into a star."
dialogues.text:
"Okay, Sakura. I have to go to school before she makes me
into a star."

dialogues.jp: しゅた、っと真面目に手を上げる。
dialogues.en: I raised my hand in serious manner.
dialogues.text: I raised my hand in serious manner.

dialogues.jp:
なぜか、さくらは音夢に視線を送りながら、上
の空に頷く。
dialogues.en: Sakura looked at Nemu for some reason and nodded.
dialogues.text: Sakura looked at Nemu for some reason and nodded.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「？　どうしたのさくら？」

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「駄目だからね音夢ちゃん。兄妹なんだから駄
　目だよ」
dialogues.en:
"You can't do that, Nemu-chan. You guys are brother and
sister. You can't do that."
dialogues.text:
"You can't do that, Nemu-chan. You guys are brother and
sister. You can't do that."

dialogues.jp:
ふたりの反応に、思わず俺も表情を消してしま
う。
dialogues.en: I couldn't do anything but look at her reaction.
dialogues.text: I couldn't do anything but look at her reaction.

dialogues.jp: 張り詰める空気が、嫌なねじれ方をしていた。
dialogues.en: It was a tense moment twisted in a weird way.
dialogues.text: It was a tense moment twisted in a weird way.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「そ、その……私……そんなつもりは……」

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「音夢ちゃん。本当は……本当の兄妹じゃなくっ
　たって駄目なんだよ」
dialogues.en:
"Nemu-chan. You can't do that, even if you two aren't really
brother and sister."
dialogues.text:
"Nemu-chan. You can't do that, even if you two aren't really
brother and sister."

dialogues.jp: 音夢の泣きそうな瞳が俺を見つめる。
dialogues.en: Nemu looked at me with tears in her eyes.
dialogues.text: Nemu looked at me with tears in her eyes.

dialogues.jp: （気づいては……いたさ）
鈍さを演じていた心が現実に裏返る。
dialogues.en: My heart felt dull, but I had to realize the truth.
dialogues.text: My heart felt dull, but I had to realize the truth.

dialogues.jp: 音夢の想いなんてすぐに分かった。
いつの頃からか。

そんなことは、掛け算よりも割り算よりも先に
理解した想いだった……。
dialogues.en:
It was something I knew before I learned multiplication or
division......
dialogues.text:
It was something I knew before I learned multiplication or
division......

dialogues.jp: 朝起きた時に覗きこんでいる瞳の中とか。
dialogues.en:
It was in her eyes when she looked into my eyes as she woke
me up.
dialogues.text:
It was in her eyes when she looked into my eyes as she woke
me up.

dialogues.jp:
休み時間のたびに俺のことを振りかえる仕草と
か。
dialogues.en: The way she turned to look at me between classes.
dialogues.text: The way she turned to look at me between classes.

dialogues.jp:
たまに一緒に下校するときに、わざと触れる腕
とか。
dialogues.en:
Or she touched my arms on purpose when we go home together
from school.
dialogues.text:
Or she touched my arms on purpose when we go home together
from school.

dialogues.jp:
おやすみの後に、いつもなにか言いたげに揺れ
る唇とか……。
dialogues.en:
And the way her lips were about to say something after she
says good night to me.
dialogues.text:
And the way her lips were about to say something after she
says good night to me.

dialogues.jp: 気づいていたさ。
「あのな、さくら……」
頭をかいて、なんと言おうか迷う。
dialogues.en: I scratched my head and thought about what I should say.
dialogues.text: I scratched my head and thought about what I should say.

dialogues.jp:
お節介だとか、無神経だとか……そんなことじゃ
なくて。
dialogues.en: Not like you're nosy or insensitive. It wasn't about that.
dialogues.text: Not like you're nosy or insensitive. It wasn't about that.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「駄目だよ音夢ちゃん」

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「お兄ちゃんをぶったらいけないんだよ。弟分
　は兄貴に手を上げてはいけないのだ♪」
dialogues.en:
"You can't hit oniichan. The younger one shouldn't raise a
hand to the older one."
dialogues.text:
"You can't hit oniichan. The younger one shouldn't raise a
hand to the older one."

dialogues.jp: 音夢が目を丸くする。

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「うにゃ、どうしたの？」

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「え、いや、なんの話だ？」
俺も音夢と同じ表情で呟く。
dialogues.en: I mumbled with same facial expression as Nemu.
dialogues.text: I mumbled with same facial expression as Nemu.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「義理と人情以外になにがあるの？」
dialogues.en: "I'm talking about justice. Is there anything else?"
dialogues.text: "I'm talking about justice. Is there anything else?"

dialogues.jp: さくらまで同じ表情になってしまう。
dialogues.en: Sakura had a confused look on her face now.
dialogues.text: Sakura had a confused look on her face now.

dialogues.jp: ジロ、と兄妹の視線がさくらに向けられる。

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「……てっしゅ〜う」

空気を察してか、さくらが逃げる様に――逃げ
なのだろうが家に帰っていく。
dialogues.en: Sakura noticed something and she went back in the house.
dialogues.text: Sakura noticed something and she went back in the house.

dialogues.jp: 思わず溜息をついてしまう。

そうだ。さくらにこそ、そんな甲斐性があるわ
けない。
dialogues.en: Come to think of it, Sakura wouldn't say such a thing.
dialogues.text: Come to think of it, Sakura wouldn't say such a thing.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「……兄さん」

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「日課……最近ごぶさただよ」
dialogues.en: "We haven't been doing the daily ritual."
dialogues.text: "We haven't been doing the daily ritual."

dialogues.jp: 音夢が前髪を持ち上げて微笑む。
「あぁ」
俺も前髪を持ち上げて、そのまま額を近づける。
dialogues.en: I lifted my bangs as well and moved close to her forehead.
dialogues.text: I lifted my bangs as well and moved close to her forehead.

dialogues.jp: 「……じっとしてろよ」

こつん、と額を合わせて、なるべく音夢から視
線をはずして呟く。
dialogues.en:
I mumbled, looking away from her as I put my forehead to her
forehead.
dialogues.text:
I mumbled, looking away from her as I put my forehead to her
forehead.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「兄さん。はじめて頭突きじゃなかったよ」
dialogues.en:
"It's the first time we've done it that you haven't
head-butted me."
dialogues.text:
"It's the first time we've done it that you haven't
head-butted me."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「そうか？」

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「うん」
あれは照れ隠しだった。
dialogues.en: I butted her head to cover my embarrassment.
dialogues.text: I butted her head to cover my embarrassment.

dialogues.jp:
そしてそれは、恥ずかしいといいつつ、ふたり
がどこかで望んでいた照れ隠しの儀式。
dialogues.en:
And it was a ceremony we both wanted to continue even though
we were both embarrassed.
dialogues.text:
And it was a ceremony we both wanted to continue even though
we were both embarrassed.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「兄さん」

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「私、ひとりで行くよ」

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「それに、熱を測るのも今日で最後ね」
dialogues.en: "And let's make it the last time you check my temperature."
dialogues.text: "And let's make it the last time you check my temperature."

dialogues.jp:
俺が驚いた隙に、音夢が１歩だけ後ろに下がっ
て笑う。
dialogues.en: Nemu stepped backward as I looked surprised.
dialogues.text: Nemu stepped backward as I looked surprised.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「めんどくさがりさんは、家で寝ててください」
dialogues.en: "Lazy bums should be sleeping at home."
dialogues.text: "Lazy bums should be sleeping at home."

dialogues.jp: その日から、音夢が口を利いてくれなくなった。
dialogues.en: And Nemu stopped talking to me after that.
dialogues.text: And Nemu stopped talking to me after that.

dialogues.jp: ◆音夢の想い◆

家の前で音夢と結婚の話をしていたら、さくら
が現れて音夢に釘をさした。
dialogues.en:
Sakura made it clear to Nemu as we were talking about
marriage in front of our house.
dialogues.text:
Sakura made it clear to Nemu as we were talking about
marriage in front of our house.

dialogues.jp:
結局、さくらは義理と人情について言ったらし
いけど……。
dialogues.en: Sakura meant to say something about justice......
dialogues.text: Sakura meant to say something about justice......

dialogues.jp:
どちらにしろ、その日から音夢が口を利いてく
れなくなった。
dialogues.en: But Nemu stopped talking to me after that day.
dialogues.text: But Nemu stopped talking to me after that day.
